about: Held-out levels: no training on them. realgame.py makes no PPO updates and collects no world-model data there; agent.py collects no world-model data, records no self-demos and charges no death or point-of-no-return memory there (runs still play them, e.g. the benchmark's held_out_levels); wm.train / wm.selfcorrect skip them. 'seen' are trained levels used for comparison.
